summary: GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8 write checkpoints to the disk cache only when they leave RAM
compatibility: With CACHE_MODE=lmcache and a disk tier, LMCACHE_L2_CHECKPOINT_WRITES now defaults to on-evict; set it to always for the previous behaviour. Give the container time to stop (the generated commands set it) so RAM-only checkpoints reach the disk.
details: Each conversation's newest checkpoint is written when it leaves RAM and at shutdown; superseded turns are never written, so the disk holds many more conversations.
Configurations without request-boundary checkpoints keep writing every cache object.
